Workspace note: `state.json` was not present in the workspace on this day; `market.csv` was present and showed 378 rows, 297 active, 81 resolved, and no active questions without a prediction.

- 407333 resolved Vinicius Junior. First-goal soccer markets remain volatile; avoid overconcentrating on the top scorer.
- 638577 resolved Oman. Iran diplomacy routings can favor Oman as mediator/next stop even when Gulf/Turkiye options look natural.
- 735499 resolved Zimbabwe. Exact health-stat markets may require keeping regional surveillance candidates alive.
- 743215 resolved El Nino. Strong WMO/ENSO evidence paid off.
- 9330 resolved European Commission. For EU operational blueprint tasks, the Commission can be the institutional drafter even when foreign-policy wording suggests EEAS/Council.

- 846721 WHCD charges official: raised Todd Blanche to 0.62 after DOJ/SPLC reporting kept Blanche as the senior DOJ face, with Kash Patel present but less likely to be the charges-announcement official.

- 927519 Nigeria orphanage kidnapping state: raised Benue to 0.45 because Apr20 reporting placed a recent child/student abduction and rescue in Benue, close to the market theme.

- Wolves/Nuggets Game 4 and Knicks triple-double: no Game 3 result yet; previews only.
